function: Predicts the NOMA and artificial-noise power allocation coefficients b1, b2, b3 at a UAV relay that minimise secrecy outage probability plus user unfairness (pp. 4, 6).
system: UAV decode-and-forward relay (H=30 m) in underlay CR-NOMA with artificial noise, two users, one eavesdropper; scalar Nakagami-m channels, antennas and band not stated, no RIS (pp. 2-5).
method: Supervised regression with DenseNet-BiLSTM (DenseNet with self-attention, BiLSTM, attention fusion), trained on exhaustive-search optimal labels with 5-fold cross-validation (pp. 6-7).
data_channel: Self-generated dataset: inputs H, rho_I, eta, rho_R, sigma_e^2; labels b1-b3 from exhaustive search of the SOP objective; Nakagami-m fading, no standard model (p. 6).
test_conditions: Trained and tested on the same dataset by 5-fold cross-validation (four folds train, one fold test); no new scenario or parameter range tested (p. 7).
baselines: Learned only: YOLOv8, Transformer, DenseNet, BiLSTM; no non-learned power allocation method compared on performance (p. 9).
metrics: R2, MSE, MAE of predicted b1, b2, b3; FLOPs, parameters, test time; analytic versus Monte Carlo SOP (pp. 5, 7, 9-10).
complexity: DenseNet-BiLSTM: 45.610 M FLOPs, 0.0749 M parameters, 20.109 ms test time (Table I, p. 10).
q1_support: p. 3: "Nakagami-m fading with path loss"; the SOP expression is simulated with a custom model, with no 3GPP, DeepMIMO, or measured channel (dataset described on p. 6).
q2_support: p. 7: "training set and the remaining one as the test set in each"; a held-out fold of the same dataset, with no other scenario, configuration, or parameter range tested.
q3_support: p. 9: "other networks, including YOLOv8, Transformer, DenseNet,"; only learned models are compared, and no non-learned method (fixed, optimization-based, or exhaustive-search allocation) is evaluated on performance.
q4_support: p. 9: "of DenseNet-BiLSTM is 20.109ms, which is 68.91% lower"; Table I (p. 10) also lists 45.610 M FLOPs and 0.0749 M parameters.
q5_support: p. 6: "The communication dataset is built based on the objective"; the dataset is self-generated, with no code or data link and no public channel dataset.
notes: Included as area 6 (borderline): the learned model sets the transmit power coefficients of a UAV relay, an aerial link (Step 1 rule 4). Nodes use scalar channels, antenna count not stated, no RIS. R2, MSE and MAE compare predictions with exhaustive-search labels, not a non-learned baseline. YOLOv8 and Transformer are learned baselines; DenseNet and BiLSTM are ablations of the proposed model.
